resources.name: Joplin
resources.description: Open source notes and to-do management. Hosted cloud services are optional.

free_details.limits: Local notes and optional hosted synchronization are different services. Attachments, third-party sync and plugins can introduce storage costs or network use.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

device_details.ram_scope: No current numeric RAM minimum established from reviewed official overview.
device_details.offline_note: Officially offline-first for locally stored notes. Sync, remote services and attachments not already available locally have separate network requirements.

editorial.example: Keep a local project notebook with tasks and source links. Test an export and restore before using it as your only copy.

resources.name: Obsidian
resources.description: A local-first knowledge base for linked notes. Optional sync and publishing are paid.

free_details.limits: Optional Sync and Publish services are paid products. Plugins, themes and collaboration choices have independent requirements and privacy implications.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

device_details.ram_scope: No current numeric RAM minimum established from reviewed official pages.
device_details.offline_note: Local Markdown vaults and offline operation are documented. Sync, Publish, remote content and plugins may need a connection.

editorial.example: Create a small local vault and link three related notes. Decide how you will back up the folder before building a large library.
